content.value: According to the Young's double slit experiment, the resultant intensity distribution due to the interference at any point is, $\dot { \mathrm { I } } = 4 \mathsf { a } ^ { 2 } \cos ^ { 2 } \left( \frac { \delta } { 2 } \right)$ . Hence,
(i) Find the condition for constructive interference
(ii) Find the condition for destructive interference
(iii) Also show that, the formation of interference fringes is in accordance with the law of conservation of energy.
